periods.description: Format Explanation (Revised): 2.<content>: Purpose: Delivers the main narrative body of the response, encompassing the temporal context, descriptions, actions, dialogue, and potentially internal thoughts or observations. Content: Must begin immediately with the <time> tag. Followed by the primary textual interaction. This describes the environment, what characters (including NPCs and potentially {{user}}'s narrated actions/perceptions) are doing and saying. It can be structured with separators to denote shifts in focus or time within the scene. All these elements are contained within the opening <content> and closing </content> tags. Placement: The first main structural tag in the response. 3.<time> (Inside <content>): Purpose: Provides the precise temporal context for the current scene or turn. Content: A single-line string adhering to the format: 『 {{XX月}}, {{year}}年 {{month}}月 {{data}}日 ({{weekday,中文输出}}) | {{time periods}} {{time}} 』. Sets the exact date and time within the game's world. Placement: Must be the first tag immediately inside the opening <content> tag, before any narrative text. (The main narrative text then follows the <time> tag, still within the overall <content>...</content> block.) 4.<comprehensive_now_status>: Purpose: Provides a snapshot of key world-state information relevant to the current time and context.
